title: ControlServiceConfiguration
description: The configuration of a control service shared between user and provider.

ServiceProviderAddress.title: ServiceProviderAddress
ServiceProviderAddress.description: Address or DNS name of the gRPC server hosting the CDDS Control Service Provider. The IP address configuration is only needed for the CDDS Control Service User.

serviceProvider.description: The name of the service provider organization providing the control service

terminal.description: Optional: The name of the terminal providing the CDDS service

address.description: The IP address or DNS resolve able name of the gRPC provider. For a provider the address can be omitted.

port.description: The TCP port of the gRPC provider

rootCertificateFile.description: The trust anchor / root certificate use to sign the CDDS user / CDDS provider certificates

certificateFile.description: The certificate file of the CDDS user or the CDDS provider

privateKeyFile.description: The private key file of the CDDS user or the CDDS provider

ControlServiceEndpoint.title: ControlServiceEndpoint
ControlServiceEndpoint.description: Allows the identification of a service endpoint in terms of the parameters provided below.

endpointName.description: An optional endpoint name to distinguish endpoints; for instance for spacecrafts supporting multiple bands.

serviceVersion.description: The CDDS service version of this service

serviceProvider.description: The name of the service provider organization providing the control service

terminal.description: The name of the terminal providing the control service

serviceUser.description: The service user (spacecraft) for which control shall be provided

functionalResourceDirectives.description: The Object identifier list of the Functional Resource Directives available for this endpoint

genericDirectiveIds.description: The list of generic control directives available for this endpoint

FunctionalResourceDirectiveName.title: FunctionalResourceDirectiveName
FunctionalResourceDirectiveName.description: Identifies a Functional Resource Directive by OID and optionally by the instance number.

functionalResourceInstance.description: The optional Functional Resource Instance number
